content.text: Ramorny and Dwining disguise Rothsay as the Duchess of Rothsay at Falkland Castle and send Charteris a forged letter to keep him away. Rothsay attempts to assault Catharine Glover, but her courage reforms him; Ramorny and Dwining later drug and imprison him in Falkland’s dungeon, where Bonthron starves him. Catharine and Louise secretly feed him, and Louise escapes to summon the Black Douglas. Douglas captures Falkland, discovers Rothsay’s murder, and executes Ramorny and Bonthron; Dwining dies by poison. Henry Wynd fights at Perth’s North Inch for Clan Chattan, defeating Eachin MacIan, who flees into the Tay and later dies at Campsie. Henry and Catharine marry. Other excerpts discuss Anglican sacraments and orders, De Maistre’s defense of papal supremacy, Parisian Latin Quarter bohemian life, and its cafés, studios, gardens, and entertainments.
